tools.name: find_relevant_cyclr_resource
tools.description: Recommend relevant Cyclr product pages, reports, case studies or resources for a SaaS integration, MCP, AI orchestration or embedded iPaaS problem.

problem.description: The user’s problem or research goal.

tools.name: get_current_page_markdown
tools.description: Return clean Markdown for the current Cyclr page using Cyclr’s dedicated agent Markdown endpoint. Canonical page URLs remain HTML-only.

tools.name: get_cyclr_content_index
tools.description: Return a curated index of important Cyclr product pages, reports, case studies and agent endpoints for public website research.

limit.description: Optional maximum number of items per section.

tools.name: get_cyclr_page_context
tools.description: Get structured context about the current Cyclr page, including title, canonical URL, meta description, page type, headings and Markdown fallback URL.

tools.name: get_cyclr_public_page_context
tools.description: Get structured metadata for a specified public Cyclr page path or URL, including canonical URL, description, headings and Markdown fallback URL.

url.description: A public Cyclr path or URL, such as /product/mcp-paas/.

tools.name: prepare_cyclr_demo_request
tools.description: Open the Cyclr Get Started page with optional interest context. This does not submit a form; the user must review and submit manually.

interest.description: The area of interest, such as embedded iPaaS, MCP PaaS, AI orchestration, connector creation or integration scaling.

tools.name: search_cyclr_connectors
tools.description: Search Cyclr connector and integration pages by app name, SaaS category or integration use case.

query.description: Application, connector, API or category to search for.

category.description: Optional connector category such as CRM, marketing, accounting, support, ecommerce or data.

tools.name: search_cyclr_site
tools.description: Search Cyclr public content for product pages, reports, resources, case studies and connector-related pages.

query.description: Search query, such as embedded iPaaS, MCP PaaS, AI orchestration, Salesforce connector or integration marketplace.
